tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Candor UI's components, hooks, blocks and patterns by what they do ("approve a tool call", "cost estimate", "session list"). Returns names, tiers and one-line descriptions; read one with get_component_docs.

tools.name: get_component_docs
tools.description: Read one item's docs as Markdown: what it is, its tier and install command, an example with the import paths an app uses, every prop, function, type, and the LocaleProvider string keys.

tools.name: suggest_components
tools.description: Describe the screen or feature you're building; get the Candor UI items that fit, why, the matching patterns, and one install command. Read each suggestion's docs before using it.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every item by group (Chat, Agent work, App shell, …), or one group's items with descriptions.

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Read a pattern as Markdown: a common problem in agent UIs (approvals, traces, cost guards, …) and the components that solve it.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: How to install Candor UI in a React or Next.js app, render a chat, connect an agent SDK, add licensed items and keep them updated.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: One item's brief to hand to the coding agent that builds the screen: the same Markdown the docs page's "Copy for a coding agent" button copies (what the item is, its tier and install command, an example with the import paths an app uses, every prop, the string keys, and the rules to keep).

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: The design system as Markdown: every colour role and what it's for, the type scale, radius, shadows, motion, density and themes, read from the shipped CSS; how an app re-tokens for its brand; and how to build the screens around Candor components (surfaces, rhythm, writing, do and don't).

tools.name: get_review_checklist
tools.description: The checklist to run after each screen where an AI agent acts, before moving on: one line per check, each tied to a rule (model output is text, unknown stays unknown, a locked control says why, nothing pre-selected, approve the exact change, reasoning is believed, the app names the agent, say what c

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "suggest_components" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Describe the screen or feature you're building; get the Candor UI items that fit, why, the matching patterns, and one install command. Read each suggestion's do…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
